parsed.explanation: The dossier documents explicit criminalisation of trans feminine presentation (Art 521, up to six years) plus a morality statute with documented arrests, raids, and intrusive forced examinations — enforced law, not a dead letter. Police targeting of trans people and a documented rise in violence in the capital are current, state-adjacent exposures. No legal gender recognition exists, and the 2022 assembly ban shows official hostility, though courts froze it. Mitigating signals: courts repeatedly declined to apply Art 534, a 2023 appellate ruling, and gradual marker-change practice. But data is thin on visitor-facing specifics — no facility rules, entry screening, or documented visitor treatment — so I extrapolate from the structural facts: enforced criminalisation of presentation, no recognition, and record of policing of trans people. That places this between the 0.25 (organised police raids/extortion) and 0.35 anchors, near 0.30.
